summary: Iteration 2 testing of Clara Frames covering all new features + regression. Backend: 53/53 pytest tests pass (29 regression from iter1 + 24 new). Frontend: full Playwright happy-path verified — MFA login → workspace switcher (create+switch, list-scoped scenes cleared correctly) → new scene creation → editor bug-fix regression PASSED (clicking a canvas element keeps properties-panel visible; clicking bare canvas background deselects). Per-element output URL (data-testid el-output-url) is populated and ends with .txt; Export page shows per-element outputs (el-out-{id}). Save/Export flow works. Users page (new-user-btn) and Settings page (settings-name, cur-pw, new-pw, change-pw-btn, reset-2fa-btn) render correctly. Dashboard clean layout (dash-new-scene, dash-search, dash-view-all) present. Backend covered: workspaces auto-create, CRUD, cascade delete, cannot-delete-last (400); scene/source scoping by workspace_id; per-element .txt/.json endpoints (text, clock format HH:mm:ss regex verified) + 404; account settings (change-password wrong/short/ok, profile update, 2FA reset+confirm returns 8 backup_codes, regen backup-codes); mfa/verify with backup code succeeds AND consumes single-use; user management (list, create, update-role, admin cannot delete self, delete, duplicate 400, non-admin 403). No new bugs found.

issues: React a11y warning still present: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent. Same low-priority polish flagged in iter1 — add DialogDescription to shadcn Dialogs.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Add DialogDescription to shadcn Dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings. Carried over from iter1 – still present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /auth/2fa/reset does not require re-authentication (current password or TOTP) — an attacker with a stolen access cookie can reset the user's TOTP secret and, after /2fa/confirm, take over MFA. Consider requiring current password + current TOTP before generating the pending secret.

server.py /users PUT endpoint accepts role changes but does not prevent an admin from demoting the last admin (could lock everyone out of user management). Consider guard: `if changing role from admin to user AND admin count == 1 -> 400`.

server.py DELETE /workspaces cascades scenes+sources but does not check ownership on cascade payload (uses user_id + workspace_id, so safe); however DELETE /workspaces/{id} does not verify the workspace actually belongs to the user before counting — count is user-scoped, so cannot delete arbitrary workspace, but returning 200 for a non-existent id is misleading (should 404).
server.py get_current_user pops totp_secret_pending BUT profile response `PUT /auth/profile` returns `{**user, **upd}` where `user` is already sanitized — good. No secret leakage observed.
server.py /public/scene/{token}/element/{id}.txt has no caching/rate-limiting; clock endpoints will be hit every 1s by vMix — fine for MVP but consider ETag or Cache-Control for image/text values.
Frontend SceneCanvas.jsx bug fix looks correct: element div uses onClick stopPropagation AND the background onClick is guarded by e.target===e.currentTarget. Verified in browser.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids and flows verified: bug fix, workspaces, per-element outputs, dashboard, users, settings)
